tagline: Built it with AI? Get it ready for real customers.

copy.headline: You built it. Let's get it ready for real customers.
copy.lead: Tell us about your app. We'll send back an honest read on what's solid, what's risky and what it would take to launch it properly.
points: We work with apps built in Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit and more.
No pitch, no pricing, nothing to sign.
copy.goalHint: What it does, how it was built, and who uses it. Rough is great.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. I built a booking app with an AI tool. 40 people use it, but I'm not sure it's safe or ready for more.
copy.finePrint: No pitch, no pricing, no budget questions. Please don't share passwords, keys or customer data.
